target_customer: Mac and Windows consumers who want a voice AI buddy that sees their screen
problem: Asking AI for help requires leaving the task to type and describe context. HeyClicky sits by the cursor, sees the screen and answers by voice or spins up background agents.
business_model: Consumer desktop app, monetization not stated in sources

founders.name: Farza Majeed
previous_startups: Buildspace (shut down in 2024 per EveryDev profile, raised $10M)
founders.background_notes: Company site names Farza as founder. The YC page lists no founders. Surname comes from a search result summary, not a page opened here.

competitors.name: Cluely
competitors.what: Invisible AI overlay capturing the screen during meetings and interviews

competitors.name: Highlight AI
competitors.what: Always-on desktop assistant reading on-screen context and transcribing meetings

technical_complexity.rationale: Built from existing APIs (the open-source repo uses Claude, AssemblyAI and ElevenLabs per a listing) with a polished cursor-side UI. Hard parts are latency and desktop integration.

defensibility.rationale: The repo is open source under MIT, and comparison sites list many alternatives, so copying is easy. Founder audience is the main edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown so far. Platform vendors were shipping screen-aware assistants in this period, which is the central risk.

market_need_then: Search showed a crowd of screen-aware assistants and comparison articles in 2026, evidence of interest but also of a crowded category. No usage numbers found.

branding.domain_note: Uses heyclicky.com with a Hey prefix.

identity.logo: Hand cursor character; a designer concept explores a 3D cursor icon system
identity.mascot_or_character: A little cursor-side buddy character per the YC launch page
identity.visual_style: Retro Mac style with window controls, beachball icons and a Hello my name is sticker

branding.brand_signature: The cursor buddy character and Hello my name is sticker

rebrands.why: Not stated by sources; one directory says HeyClicky was formerly Clicky

branding.community_and_virality: Started as a viral open-source demo by Farza; a designer posted an unsolicited brand exploration after Farza asked designers publicly, per a Contra portfolio page.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong personality and founder audience that produced open-source forks and fan design work, but the name is confusable with Clicky web analytics and many unrelated Clicky results.

outcome_analysis: HeyClicky is an active Spring 2026 YC company that grew from a viral open-source demo by a founder with an existing builder audience, which gave it distribution and brand pull. No outcome exists yet. The risks are weak defensibility and platform vendors shipping similar screen-aware assistants.
notes: Confidence low because founder education and prior employers were not found in an opened source. Funding unverified: CB Insights shows a $0.5M convertible note on 2026-05-01 with Y Combinator and VCBacked shows pre-seed in 2026-06; this matches YC's standard deal, so not recorded as a round. One page claimed about $10M, which EveryDev attributes to Buildspace history, not HeyClicky. YC page lists no founders and team size 0 in the directory. No shutdown or acquisition found. Competitor sources are vendor SEO blogs and unverified. Completeness pass: CB Insights reports a $0.5M convertible note dated 2026-05-01 with Y Combinator, now recorded as an other round; it rests on a single database and is likely YC's standard deal. Caplight dates an accelerator round 2026-01 and VCBacked says pre-seed 2026-06, so date and instrument conflict. No press release confirms it.
